reviews.text: Unbelievable service and attention to detail.  They treat you with respect.  They also don’t leave any mess around. I appreciate that they carried off all the old fencing.  Would use again and again
reviews.author: Marks Lanham

reviews.text: We used Cleburne Fence to replace the chain link fence around our childcare center playground. They also extended it to give our children more room to play. The fence is gorgeous, and they were done in a timely manner. They didn’t leave any trash behind or any hazards for our children. They were very professional, and did fantastic work.
reviews.author: Jessica George

reviews.text: So happy with our new fence. The team at Cleburne fence did an outstanding job and I love the stain provided by Tony Newsom. I highly recommend this team!!
reviews.author: Debbie Hoekstra

reviews.text: The fence turned out even better than I imagined! Like anything involving Texas dirt and Mother Nature, not everything went exactly as planned — but these folks went above and beyond to make sure everything was right and I was 100% happy in the end. Great work, great team, and a fence that looks damn good!
reviews.author: Mike Clemen

reviews.text: Had chain link fence installed and one side updated with new cedar boards.  Job was completed in a very timely manner and looks awesome!
reviews.author: Bridgett Sawyer

reviews.text: We needed a fence quickly for our dogs and Cleburne Fence came through! Reasonable prices, good quality, timely, and professional! Thank you!
reviews.author: MF

reviews.text: Cleburne Fence did an amazing job!  Ryan and Jason were both great to work with. Since my husband died a few years ago, I didn’t want to attempt just a large project but Cleburne Fence made it so easy.  Now I can actually enjoy my backyard for the very first time. Thank you.
reviews.author: Shirley T.

reviews.text: Ryan came out to give estimate for new fence with gate. He was very professional and pleasant to work with.  The gentlemen who  built the fence and gate as well as the replacement of a section of fence did a great job. Well built and they cleaned up after themselves.
reviews.author: Lorraine Allen
